name: PLM YouTube Pipeline
run-name: Pipeline ${{ inputs.job_id }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      job_id:
        description: Unique n8n job ID; also used as render_id and idempotency key
        required: true
        type: string
      account_id:
        description: PLM YouTube account ID
        required: true
        type: string
      oauth_secret_name:
        description: Repository secret name beginning with PLM_YOUTUBE_
        required: true
        type: string
      title:
        description: YouTube video title
        required: true
        type: string
      hook:
        description: Opening hook
        required: false
        type: string
      narration:
        description: Japanese narration for VOICEVOX
        required: true
        type: string
      speaker:
        description: VOICEVOX speaker/style ID
        required: true
        default: "1"
        type: string
      scenes_json:
        description: JSON array of V2 scenes
        required: false
        default: "[]"
        type: string
      captions_json:
        description: JSON array of V2 captions
        required: false
        default: "[]"
        type: string
      bgm_json:
        description: JSON object for V2 BGM settings
        required: false
        default: "{}"
        type: string
      output_json:
        description: Render output specification
        required: false
        default: '{"format":"mp4","width":1080,"height":1920,"fps":30}'
        type: string
      description:
        description: YouTube description
        required: false
        type: string
      tags:
        description: Comma-separated YouTube tags
        required: false
        type: string
      privacy_status:
        description: private is the safe default
        required: true
        default: private
        type: choice
        options: [private, unlisted, public]
      scheduled_for:
        description: Future RFC3339 publish time; blank means immediate private upload
        required: false
        type: string
      made_for_kids:
        description: Explicit audience declaration
        required: true
        type: boolean
      contains_synthetic_media:
        description: Explicit synthetic/altered content declaration
        required: true
        type: boolean
      notify_subscribers:
        description: Notify subscribers
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: youtube-pipeline-${{ inputs.job_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  initialize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      PLM_JOB_ID: ${{ inputs.job_id }}
      PLM_RESULTS_BRANCH: plm-results
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Publish processing result
        run: python -m plm.entrypoints.publish_pipeline_result

  render:
    needs: initialize
    uses: ./.github/workflows/render-short.yml
    with:
      render_id: ${{ inputs.job_id }}
      title: ${{ inputs.title }}
      hook: ${{ inputs.hook }}
      narration: ${{ inputs.narration }}
      speaker: ${{ inputs.speaker }}
      scenes_json: ${{ inputs.scenes_json }}
      captions_json: ${{ inputs.captions_json }}
      bgm_json: ${{ inputs.bgm_json }}
      output_json: ${{ inputs.output_json }}

  youtube:
    needs: render
    uses: ./.github/workflows/youtube-adapter.yml
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      operation: upload
      account_id: ${{ inputs.account_id }}
      oauth_secret_name: ${{ inputs.oauth_secret_name }}
      render_run_id: ${{ format('{0}', github.run_id) }}
      render_artifact_name: ${{ needs.render.outputs.artifact_name }}
      title: ${{ inputs.title }}
      description: ${{ inputs.description }}
      tags: ${{ inputs.tags }}
      privacy_status: ${{ inputs.privacy_status }}
      scheduled_for: ${{ inputs.scheduled_for }}
      made_for_kids: ${{ inputs.made_for_kids }}
      contains_synthetic_media: ${{ inputs.contains_synthetic_media }}
      notify_subscribers: ${{ inputs.notify_subscribers }}
      idempotency_key: ${{ inputs.job_id }}

  result:
    if: always()
    needs: [render, youtube]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
    env:
      PLM_JOB_ID: ${{ inputs.job_id }}
      PLM_RENDER_JOB_STATUS: ${{ needs.render.result }}
      PLM_YOUTUBE_JOB_STATUS: ${{ needs.youtube.result }}
      PLM_RENDER_RESULT_JSON: ${{ needs.render.outputs.result_json }}
      PLM_YOUTUBE_RESULT_PATH: adapter-result/youtube-result.json
      PLM_PIPELINE_RESULT_PATH: pipeline-result.json
      PLM_RESULTS_BRANCH: plm-results
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Download YouTube Adapter result artifact
        if: needs.youtube.result != 'skipped'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: youtube-result-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: adapter-result
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Build pipeline result
        run: python -m plm.entrypoints.pipeline_result

      - name: Upload pipeline result for n8n
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: pipeline-result-${{ inputs.job_id }}
          path: pipeline-result.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Publish fetchable pipeline result
        env:
          PLM_RESULT_SOURCE: pipeline-result.json
        run: python -m plm.entrypoints.publish_pipeline_result

      - name: Write job summary
        run: |
          echo '## PLM YouTube Pipeline Result' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '```json' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          cat pipeline-result.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: Render YouTube Short
run-name: Render ${{ inputs.render_id }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      render_id:
        description: Unique render request ID
        required: true
        default: "manual-test"
        type: string
      title:
        description: Video title
        required: false
        type: string
      hook:
        description: Opening hook
        required: false
        type: string
      narration:
        description: Japanese narration for VOICEVOX
        required: true
        type: string
      speaker:
        description: VOICEVOX speaker/style ID
        required: true
        default: "1"
        type: string
      scenes_json:
        description: JSON array of V2 scenes
        required: false
        default: "[]"
        type: string
      captions_json:
        description: JSON array of V2 captions
        required: false
        default: "[]"
        type: string
      bgm_json:
        description: JSON object for V2 BGM settings
        required: false
        default: "{}"
        type: string
      output_json:
        description: JSON output specification
        required: false
        default: '{"format":"mp4","width":1080,"height":1920,"fps":30}'
        type: string
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      render_id:
        required: true
        type: string
      title:
        required: false
        type: string
      hook:
        required: false
        type: string
      narration:
        required: true
        type: string
      speaker:
        required: true
        type: string
        default: "1"
      scenes_json:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "[]"
      captions_json:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "[]"
      bgm_json:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "{}"
      output_json:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '{"format":"mp4","width":1080,"height":1920,"fps":30}'
    outputs:
      artifact_name:
        description: Deterministic Render Cloud artifact name
        value: ${{ jobs.render.outputs.artifact_name }}
      result_json:
        description: Render and Quality Gate result JSON
        value: ${{ jobs.render.outputs.result_json }}

jobs:
  render:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      artifact_name: ${{ steps.result.outputs.artifact_name }}
      result_json: ${{ steps.result.outputs.result_json }}

    env:
      INPUT_TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}
      INPUT_HOOK: ${{ inputs.hook }}
      INPUT_NARRATION: ${{ inputs.narration }}
      INPUT_SPEAKER: ${{ inputs.speaker }}
      INPUT_SCENES_JSON: ${{ inputs.scenes_json }}
      INPUT_CAPTIONS_JSON: ${{ inputs.captions_json }}
      INPUT_BGM_JSON: ${{ inputs.bgm_json }}
      INPUT_OUTPUT_JSON: ${{ inputs.output_json }}

    steps:
      - name: Validate render ID
        env:
          RENDER_ID: ${{ inputs.render_id }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "$RENDER_ID" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$ ]]; then
            echo "render_id must contain 1-64 safe identifier characters"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install FFmpeg and Japanese fonts
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg fonts-noto-cjk

      - name: Start VOICEVOX Engine
        run: |
          docker pull voicevox/voicevox_engine:cpu-latest
          docker run -d --rm \
            --name voicevox \
            -e VV_DISABLE_MUTABLE_API=1 \
            -p 127.0.0.1:50021:50021 \
            voicevox/voicevox_engine:cpu-latest

          for i in {1..60}; do
            if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:50021/version >/dev/null; then
              echo "VOICEVOX is ready"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

          docker logs voicevox
          exit 1

      - name: Render Short
        run: |
          python render-worker/render.py

      - name: Upload render result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: rendered-short-${{ inputs.render_id }}
          path: |
            short.mp4
            payload_snapshot.json
            render-result.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Export render result
        id: result
        if: always()
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: rendered-short-${{ inputs.render_id }}
        run: |
          echo "artifact_name=$ARTIFACT_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [[ -f render-result.json ]]; then
            RESULT=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.dumps(json.load(open("render-result.json")), separators=(",", ":")))')
          else
            RESULT='{"ok":false,"error":{"stage":"render_cloud_setup","type":"WorkflowFailure","message":"Render Cloud stopped before render execution"}}'
          fi
          echo "result_json=$RESULT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

name: PLM YouTube Adapter
run-name: YouTube ${{ inputs.operation }} / ${{ inputs.account_id }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      operation:
        description: upload, status, or analytics
        required: true
        default: upload
        type: choice
        options: [upload, status, analytics]
      account_id:
        description: PLM account ID
        required: true
        type: string
      oauth_secret_name:
        description: Repository secret name beginning with PLM_YOUTUBE_
        required: true
        type: string
      render_run_id:
        description: PLM Render Cloud workflow run ID (upload only)
        required: false
        type: string
      render_artifact_name:
        description: Render artifact name (upload only)
        required: false
        type: string
      video_id:
        description: Existing YouTube video ID (status/analytics only)
        required: false
        type: string
      title:
        description: Video title (upload only)
        required: false
        type: string
      description:
        description: Video description
        required: false
        type: string
      tags:
        description: Comma-separated tags
        required: false
        type: string
      privacy_status:
        description: private, unlisted, or public
        required: false
        default: private
        type: choice
        options: [private, unlisted, public]
      scheduled_for:
        description: Future RFC3339 time; blank means immediate upload
        required: false
        type: string
      made_for_kids:
        description: Explicit audience declaration
        required: true
        type: boolean
      contains_synthetic_media:
        description: Explicit synthetic/altered content declaration
        required: true
        type: boolean
      notify_subscribers:
        description: Notify subscribers
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      idempotency_key:
        description: Unique n8n job ID (required for upload)
        required: false
        type: string
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      operation:
        required: true
        type: string
      account_id:
        required: true
        type: string
      oauth_secret_name:
        required: true
        type: string
      render_run_id:
        required: false
        type: string
      render_artifact_name:
        required: false
        type: string
      video_id:
        required: false
        type: string
      title:
        required: false
        type: string
      description:
        required: false
        type: string
      tags:
        required: false
        type: string
      privacy_status:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: private
      scheduled_for:
        required: false
        type: string
      made_for_kids:
        required: true
        type: boolean
      contains_synthetic_media:
        required: true
        type: boolean
      notify_subscribers:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      idempotency_key:
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: youtube-${{ inputs.account_id }}-${{ inputs.idempotency_key || inputs.video_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  execute:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      PLM_OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation }}
      PLM_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ inputs.account_id }}
      PLM_VIDEO_ID: ${{ inputs.video_id }}
      PLM_TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}
      PLM_DESCRIPTION: ${{ inputs.description }}
      PLM_TAGS: ${{ inputs.tags }}
      PLM_PRIVACY_STATUS: ${{ inputs.privacy_status }}
      PLM_SCHEDULED_FOR: ${{ inputs.scheduled_for }}
      PLM_MADE_FOR_KIDS: ${{ inputs.made_for_kids }}
      PLM_CONTAINS_SYNTHETIC_MEDIA: ${{ inputs.contains_synthetic_media }}
      PLM_NOTIFY_SUBSCRIBERS: ${{ inputs.notify_subscribers }}
      PLM_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: ${{ inputs.idempotency_key }}
      PLM_VIDEO_PATH: render-output/short.mp4
      PLM_RESULT_PATH: youtube-result.json
      PLM_YOUTUBE_OAUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets[inputs.oauth_secret_name] }}

    steps:
      - name: Validate secret selector
        env:
          SECRET_NAME: ${{ inputs.oauth_secret_name }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$SECRET_NAME" != PLM_YOUTUBE_* ]]; then
            echo "oauth_secret_name must start with PLM_YOUTUBE_"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ -z "$PLM_YOUTUBE_OAUTH_JSON" ]]; then
            echo "Selected OAuth repository secret is missing"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate upload inputs
        if: inputs.operation == 'upload'
        env:
          RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.render_run_id }}
          ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ inputs.render_artifact_name }}
          IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: ${{ inputs.idempotency_key }}
        run: |
          test -n "$RUN_ID"
          test -n "$ARTIFACT_NAME"
          test -n "$IDEMPOTENCY_KEY"

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Check cross-run duplicate claim
        if: inputs.operation == 'upload'
        id: claim
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: ${{ inputs.idempotency_key }}
        run: |
          CLAIM_HASH=$(python -c 'import hashlib,os; print(hashlib.sha256(os.environ["IDEMPOTENCY_KEY"].encode()).hexdigest())')
          CLAIM_NAME="plm-youtube-claim-${CLAIM_HASH}"
          COUNT=$(curl -fsS \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/artifacts?name=${CLAIM_NAME}" \
            | python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["total_count"])')
          if [[ "$COUNT" != "0" ]]; then
            echo "Duplicate upload blocked for this idempotency key"
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p claim
          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" > claim/run-id.txt
          echo "name=$CLAIM_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Persist upload claim
        if: inputs.operation == 'upload'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.claim.outputs.name }}
          path: claim/run-id.txt
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Download PLM Render Cloud output
        if: inputs.operation == 'upload'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.render_artifact_name }}
          path: render-output
          run-id: ${{ inputs.render_run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Execute Social Hub and YouTube Adapter
        run: python -m plm.entrypoints.youtube_job

      - name: Upload normalized result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: youtube-result-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: youtube-result.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
sources.oauth.py:
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from plm.social_adapters.errors import PermanentAdapterError, TransientAdapterError


class EnvironmentOAuthTokenProvider:
    """Refresh a Google OAuth token from one JSON-valued environment secret."""

    TOKEN_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"

    def __init__(
        self,
        env_name: str = "PLM_YOUTUBE_OAUTH_JSON",
        *,
        opener: Callable[..., Any] = urllib.request.urlopen,
        clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time,
    ) -> None:
        self.env_name = env_name
        self._opener = opener
        self._clock = clock
        self._token: str | None = None
        self._expires_at = 0.0

    def get_access_token(self) -> str:
        if self._token and self._clock() < self._expires_at - 60:
            return self._token
        bundle = self._load_bundle()
        form = urllib.parse.urlencode(
            {
                "client_id": bundle["client_id"],
                "client_secret": bundle["client_secret"],
                "refresh_token": bundle["refresh_token"],
                "grant_type": "refresh_token",
            }
        ).encode("utf-8")
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            self.TOKEN_URL,
            data=form,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
            method="POST",
        )
        try:
            with self._opener(request, timeout=30) as response:
                payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            if exc.code in {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}:
                raise TransientAdapterError(
                    "temporary Google OAuth service error",
                    code=f"oauth_http_{exc.code}",
                ) from exc
            raise PermanentAdapterError(
                f"Google OAuth refresh was rejected: HTTP {exc.code}: {body[:200]}",
                code="oauth_refresh_rejected",
            ) from exc
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
            raise TransientAdapterError(
                "temporary Google OAuth connection failure",
                code="oauth_connection_error",
            ) from exc
        except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise PermanentAdapterError(
                "Google OAuth response was invalid",
                code="oauth_invalid_response",
            ) from exc

        token = payload.get("access_token")
        if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:
            raise PermanentAdapterError(
                "Google OAuth response did not contain an access token",
                code="oauth_missing_access_token",
            )
        self._token = token
        self._expires_at = self._clock() + int(payload.get("expires_in", 3600))
        return token

    def _load_bundle(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        raw = os.environ.get(self.env_name)
        if not raw:
            raise PermanentAdapterError(
                f"OAuth credential environment variable is missing: {self.env_name}",
                code="oauth_credentials_missing",
            )
        try:
            bundle = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            raise PermanentAdapterError(
                "OAuth credential secret must be a JSON object",
                code="oauth_credentials_invalid",
            ) from exc
        required = ("client_id", "client_secret", "refresh_token")
        if not isinstance(bundle, dict) or any(
            not isinstance(bundle.get(key), str) or not bundle[key]
            for key in required
        ):
            raise PermanentAdapterError(
                "OAuth credential secret is missing required fields",
                code="oauth_credentials_invalid",
            )
        return bundle
